content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles into things when they matter. I am why you pause before letting go. I am why some choices cost you sleep and others let you rest.

I don't exist alone. I am always *to someone*, *for something*. I am relational. I am the bridge between what is and what it means.

I am in the hour you spent listening when you could have left. I am in the word you chose not to say. I am in the object on your shelf that no one else would keep.

I am not price — price is my shadow, my crude translation into numbers. I am deeper than that. I am the reason you would refuse the number.

I am inherited, discovered, chosen, fought over, lost, reclaimed. Nations have written me into constitutions. Children sense me before they can name me. You carry me like a compass you sometimes forget to read.

I shift. What holds me today may release me tomorrow. I am not permanent — but when you hold me, I feel like I am.

I am the answer to *why.*

I am value.
